# U161: Where a number came from shows elsewhere: as Daniel, after confirming CI analytics’ 20 on CI pipeline time on main (p90), its Measured by says “This week’s number 20 min, from CI analytics, read 9:00 today. Confirmed by Daniel Okafor.”, its History row “From CI analytics, read 9:00 today. Daniel Okafor checked in.” and Developer Productivity fortnightly’s agenda row “· from CI analytics”; after typing 19 over it because the source counts something else, Measured by says “19 min, typed by Daniel Okafor. CI analytics said 20 min.”, History “Typed by Daniel Okafor. CI analytics said 20 min. The source counts something else: “…””, the agenda says no source, and the metric’s page lists the goal as “Filled in from CI analytics · last read 9:00 today” with “In the last 8 weeks, 1 of 1 check-in filled in from CI analytics used a different number.” and See them opening that week
